{{Quote|My duty is to kill all enemies of the Republic.|Faie|<ref name="Republic 81" />}}
'''Faie''' was a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]], [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], and others, during the height of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Faie served within the [[7th Legion]], as well as [[Gender/Legends|his]] own [[Faie's battle group|battle group]] during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]].

==Biography==
===Siege of Saleucami===
[[File:Faie-Saleucami.png|thumb|left|245px|Commander Faie, at the Republic's base on Saleucami.]]
[[Reproduction/Legends|Grown]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] of the [[Clone template/Legends|prime clone]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], the basis of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Army/Legends|army]],<ref name="DB Clone Troopers" /> Faie was one of the first hundred [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commanders]] put through [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17's]] training program.<ref name="Hasbro" /> [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Faie served during the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]] under the leadership of multiple [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]], including [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]], [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]. Faie served alongside [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|CC-5052]] "Bly" and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]],<ref name="Republic 74">[[Republic 74|''Republic'' 74]]</ref> as part of its [[7th Legion]],<ref name="Hasbro" /> along with the [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps/Legends|91st Mobile Recon Corps]] and its Marshal Commander [[Neyo/Legends|CC-8826]] "Neyo."<ref name="Fact File 19">{{FactFile2014|19|NEY 1-4|Commander Neyo}}</ref>

During the five&mdash;[[Standard month|month]] siege,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref><ref name="DT 6">[[Dark Times 6|''Dark Times'' 6]]</ref> Commander Faie was stationed at the Republic base and ensured that [[General/Legends|General]] Rancisis's quarters were ready. 
Faie was present outside when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance's]] forces assassinated the general.<ref name="Republic 75">[[Republic 75|''Republic'' 75]]</ref> Eventually, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] emerged victorious on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] when the [[Morgukai Shadow Army]] [[Saleucami Cloning Complex|cloning facilities]] were destroyed by an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] from the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]].<ref name="Republic 77">[[Republic 77|''Republic'' 77]]</ref>

===Battle of Kashyyyk===
[[File:Faie-Phase-2-Armor.png|thumb|right|235px|Commander Faie participated in the Battle of Kashyyyk since the early stages of the conflict.]]
Following the Siege of Saleucami, Faie was dispatched to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]],<ref name="Republic 81">[[Republic 81|''Republic'' 81]]</ref> and placed in command of a [[Faie's battle group|battle group]] that was composed of a [[Unidentified clone scout battalion|battalion]] of [[Clone scout trooper/Legends|clone scout troopers]] from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], a [[Troop/Legends|troop]] of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]], and light aerial cavalry from the [[7th Aleena Reconnaissance Regiment]].<ref name="EGTW Cut 9">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-9-battlfields-of-the-clone-wars|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 9: Battlefields of the Clone Wars}}</ref> During Faie's time on Kashyyyk he was placed under the command of Quinlan Vos,<ref name="Republic 81" /> and worked with Jedi General [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]]<ref name="Republic 81" /> and her [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]].<ref name="CSWE" />

===Hunting the Jedi===
{{Quote|I'm calling down an airstrike, Vos. Kill you, me, that Wookiee village nearby - everyone. One big crater unless you surrender yourself and die. I've got my duty and I'll see it done!|Faie|<ref name="Republic 83" />}}
[[File:TheDeathofFaie.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Quinlan Vos and Faie.]]
When the Separatists moved against the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], Faie,<ref name="Republic 82" /> [[Senior clone commander|Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|CC-1004]] "Gree", and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were there to meet them. As the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|fighting]] for the city intensified, both Gree<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> and Faie received [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] directly from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself. Acting without hesitation, Faie and his [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] troops moved against Generals Vos and Undulli before they could catch wind of what was going on. Only Vos escaped with his life.<ref name="Republic 83" /> After the death of Gree,<ref name="ROTS" /> the burden of orchestrating the defense of Kashyyyk and hunting down the surviving Jedi fell upon Faie's shoulders.<ref name="Republic 83" />

Faie's search for the fugitive Vos took him and the clone troopers of [[Bogey Squad]] deep into the heart of Kashyyyk's thick [[Forest/Legends|forests]], where he demanded that Vos reveal himself and face justice, or Faie would call in an orbital bombardment that would destroy himself, the Jedi, and a nearby village of innocent Wookiees. Knowing that Faie planned to raze the village even if he managed to kill Vos, the Jedi leapt from the [[Tree/Legends|trees]], [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at the ready. Despite Faie managing to shoot the Jedi in the chest, the shot didn't prove fatal. Vos killed the clone commander with a single stroke of [[Quinlan Vos's lightsaber/Legends|his weapon]].<ref name="Republic 83" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I am giving you a direct order, Commander. Which order takes precedence?"<br />"Generals in the field take precedence, sir.| Quinlan Vos and Faie|<ref name="Republic 82" />}}
[[File:Faie-Luminara-Quinlan.png|thumb|left|240px|Obedient to the command code, Clone Commander Faie followed Quinlan's orders, usually after multiple disagreements.]]
Commander Faie was the ideal clone envisioned by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] cloners on Kamino and embodied by the vast majority of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Clone Army]].<ref name="TCD">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref> He abided by a strict adherence to the [[Command Code]]. Unlike some of his brethren, he showed little interest in developing himself as an individual and strictly maintained himself as—what all clones were created to be—a soldier bred to fight and die for the Republic.<ref name="Republic 81" /> Faie disliked the Jedi Order and his by-the-book personality often put him at odds with his Jedi superiors. This was especially true with the Jedi General Quinlan Vos, whom Faie deeply disliked. <ref name="Republic 82" />

Faie followed orders, no matter his personal stance on that matter, though he preferred to make his feelings known. <ref name="Republic 81" /> Faie's obedience was so extreme he was perfectly willing to kill himself and an entire Wookiee village via orbital bombardment just to fulfill Order 66 and eliminate his former superior officer, General Vos.<ref name="Republic 83" />

==Equipment==
[[File:FullFaie-TCWBRBD1.png|thumb|right|180px|Commander Faie in clone engineer armor with tunic and belt, and holding a DC-15A blaster]]
Commander Faie, like other clone troopers, owned a set of [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]]. Faie wore multiple sets through the war, including white [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|phase II clone armor]] with the [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] of a [[clone engineer]]. This armor featured the markings of the 7th Legion, and he wore a [[Color/Legends|white]] tunic and [[Cape/Legends|cape]] alongside it.<ref name="Hasbro" /> Faie also utilized a separate set of white phase II armor with the yellow markings of the 7th Legion's parent unit, the 327th Star Corps. In this armor, Faie was equipped with an orange [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]], a beige [[Kama/Legends|kama]], and dual [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistol]] holsters.<ref name="Republic 81" /> For his operations on Kashyyyk, Faie adopted a standard green camouflaged set of clone scout armor.<ref name="Republic 82" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clone Commander Faie first appeared in [[Republic 74|''Republic'' 74]], a comic issue that was released on [[March 23]], [[2005]].<ref name="74 Date">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/10-440/Star-Wars-Republic-74|text=Star Wars: Republic #74}}</ref> Faie was created for and initially slated to appear in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] as a [[BARC speeder/Legends|speeder]] pilot on Saleucami. However, this clone was later switched to the Neyo model and as a result the Faie model never appeared in the film.<ref name="Neyo DB>{{DB|character|commanderneyo|Neyo, Commander}}</ref>

Faie [[Tuckerization|was named]] after Art Department Supervisor [[Fay David]].<ref name="Neyo DB />
